inputs.original_text: Listen, it appears Cuba is heading toward a political transition, but its people own nothing and are far too poor to acquire the few businesses that are still running. This situation invites the wealthy diaspora community and foreign investors to swoop in and purchase property and businesses at bargain prices. Such outcomes stem directly from decades of government overreach that destroys private ownership and family wealth. This is a powerful illustration of why nations need to prioritize tradition, authority, nationalism, family values, and cultural continuity over any form of centralized control that renders citizens powerless and invites outsiders to exploit the situation.
